duplicate_risk.evidence: Page 6: 'A companion study showed that these two mixtures are more efficient than conventional pyrethroid-treated nets against susceptible and resistant An. gambiae populations and did not induce any additional selective pressure on the resistance genes, Ace1R and Kdr [15].' (Ref 15: Pennetier et al. 2008 Emerg Infect Dis). Samples may overlap with this companion study.

supplement.evidence: Genotype frequencies and sample sizes for kdr and Ace-1 are reported in Table 1 in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy and behavioral responses of free-flying Anopheles gambiae to bed nets impregnated with pirimiphos-methyl (PM) combined with repellents (DEET or KBR 3023) in experimental huts in Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso in 2006. Genotyping of control hut mosquitoes confirmed the presence and frequencies of Vgsc L995F (kdr) and Ace-1 G280S (Ace-1R) alleles across dry and rainy seasons.
